decisions.reason: The source changes only the crop of a specific page-24 photo; it does not change the document's general layout, spacing, coverage, or background treatment.
Showing more of the tree in one photo does not change the Agua Arc brand identity or required brand assets.
The page-24 photo crop has no effect on the supplied tables, their replacement, or their integration into the proposal.
The photo-cropping request does not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the saved proposal.
The source concerns only the visible crop of a photo and does not resolve or change narrative content, section order, or the Section 6 ambiguity.
A requested photo adjustment does not change Canva ownership, edit access, asset policy, or source-file reuse rights.
The request targets a photo on page 24, not the cover letter, its one-page limit, signature, or relocation of cover-letter images.
The page-24 image crop does not change the final PDF format, file count, export quality, or email-submission constraints.
The source applies to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and does not affect the TPEC proposal design requirement.
Adjusting the crop within an existing page does not necessarily change page count or the established page-reduction approach.
The message supplies one revision comment but does not change the allowed revision-round count or the trigger for performing final revisions.
The photo-cropping request does not modify any draft, revision, submission, or delivery deadline.
